lead.titleZh: 小腿损伤：基于解剖学方法进行诊断、管理和重返运动
lead.titleEn: Calf Injuries: Anatomy-Based Approach to Diagnosis, Management and Return to Sport
lead.paragraphZh: 今天共 curated 7 篇文章，涵盖 4 个专业方向，值得关注的是一篇 80 分的综述，主要讨论小腿损伤的诊断、管理和重返运动。另有两项 75 分的研究，一项是述评，关注围囊神经组阻滞在康复医学中的应用，另一项是观察研究，探讨剪切波弹性成像评估腰部多裂肌弹性。
lead.paragraphEn: Today's curation includes 7 articles across 4 specialties, with a notable 80-point review on an anatomy-based approach to calf injury diagnosis, management, and return to sport. Additionally, two 75-point studies are featured: an opinion paper on pericapsular nerve group blocks in rehabilitation medicine, and an observational study assessing shear wave elastography for lumbar multifidus muscle elasticity.

items.title:
The Pericapsular Nerve Group (PENG) block in physical and rehabilitation medicine: an opinion paper
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summary: An opinion paper explores the application of the Pericapsular Nerve Group (PENG) block in physical and rehabilitation medicine, discussing its potential for hip pain management and integration into rehabilitation protocols.
items.curatedReason: 这篇专家意见论文为物理治疗和康复医学领域的临床医师提供了关于 PENG 阻滞的最新应用视图，包括其在髋关节疼痛管理和康复中的潜在角色。
items.titleZh: 围囊神经组 (PENG) 阻滞在物理与康复医学中的应用：一篇专家意见论文
items.summaryZh: 一篇专家意见论文探讨了围囊神经组（PENG）阻滞在物理和康复医学中的应用，讨论了其在髋关节疼痛管理和康复方案整合中的潜在作用。
items.curatedReasonEn: This opinion paper provides clinicians in physical and rehabilitation medicine with an updated view on the application of the Pericapsular Nerve Group (PENG) block, including its potential role in hip pain management and rehabilitation.

items.title: Early clinical outcomes and learning curve study of robot-assisted precision osteotomy in total knee arthroplasty in the context of enhanced recovery after surgery
items.summary: A study (n=130) comparing robot-assisted (RA-TKA) and conventional manual (CM-TKA) total knee arthroplasty found RA-TKA resulted in better reconstruction of lower limb force lines (HKA 179.1 ± 1.0 vs 176.7 ± 1.7, P < 0.001) and precise prosthesis implantation, with a learning curve of approximately 22 cases, though surgical time was 11.3 minutes longer.
items.curatedReason: HURWA 机器人辅助全膝关节置换术（RA-TKA）能更好地重建下肢力线和精确植入假体，但手术时间略长且学习曲线约为 22 例。临床医师在与骨科同事讨论 TKA 方案时，可了解机器人辅助 TKA 的早期临床特征。
items.titleZh: 机器人辅助精确截骨全膝关节置换术在加速康复外科背景下的早期临床结果及学习曲线研究
items.summaryZh: 一项比较机器人辅助（RA-TKA）和传统人工（CM-TKA）全膝关节置换术的研究（n=130）发现，RA-TKA 在下肢力线重建（HKA 179.1 ± 1.0 vs 176.7 ± 1.7, P < 0.001）和假体精确植入方面表现更优，学习曲线约为 22 例，但手术时间比传统方法长约 11.3 分钟。
items.curatedReasonEn: HURWA robot-assisted total knee arthroplasty (RA-TKA) achieves better lower limb force line reconstruction and precise prosthesis implantation, though with slightly longer surgical times and a learning curve of approximately 22 cases. Clinicians discussing TKA options with orthopedic colleagues can consider these early clinical characteristics of RA-TKA.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心回顾性研究，且随访时间仅为早期临床结果，可能无法完全反映长期疗效和并发症。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center retrospective study with early clinical outcomes only, which may not fully reflect long-term efficacy and complications.

items.title: Calf Injuries: An Anatomy-Based Approach to Diagnosis, Management and Return to Sport.
items.summary: A review highlights that anatomical characterization of calf muscle injuries, including gastrocnemius-soleus, is useful for understanding heterogeneity, but clinical management and return-to-sport decisions should prioritize progressive, criteria-based loading over isolated imaging findings.
items.curatedReason: 对于小腿肌肉损伤，解剖学定位确实能帮助我们理解损伤的异质性，但别因此就过度依赖影像结果。更重要的是，重返运动应严格遵循渐进式、基于功能表现的负荷标准，而非单一的影像学发现。
items.titleZh: 小腿损伤：基于解剖学的方法诊断、管理和重返运动
items.summaryZh: 一份综述指出，小腿肌肉（包括腓肠肌和比目鱼肌）损伤的解剖学特征有助于理解其异质性，但临床管理和重返运动决策应优先考虑渐进的、基于标准的负荷，而非孤立的影像学发现。
items.curatedReasonEn: Anatomical characterization of calf muscle injuries is helpful for understanding their heterogeneity, but don't over-rely on imaging findings. Return-to-sport decisions should prioritize progressive, criteria-based loading over isolated imaging results.
items.limitation: 目前关于特定解剖模式与预后及重返运动结果之间关联的证据有限且多为观察性。
items.limitationEn: Evidence linking specific anatomical patterns to prognosis and return-to-sport outcomes remains limited and largely observational.

items.title: rehabilitation Archives - BJSM blog - social media's leading SEM voice
items.summary: This BJSM blog archive page aggregates recent articles on rehabilitation topics, including musculoskeletal barriers, neuroplastic periodization for tendinopathy, Olympic injury surveillance, Achilles tendinopathy, arthrogenic muscle inhibition after ACL reconstruction, and hamstring injuries, without a specific new event.
items.curatedReason: 这不是一篇新闻报道，也未发布新的研究。它只是BJSM博客的一个存档页面，聚合了近期关于肌骨障碍、肌腱病神经可塑性、ACL重建术后关节源性肌肉抑制等康复热点文章的链接。如果你想快速浏览这些话题，可以点击查看。
items.titleZh: 康复档案 - BJSM 博客 - 社交媒体领先的运动与运动医学之声
items.summaryZh: BJSM 博客此归档页面汇集了关于康复主题的近期文章，包括肌肉骨骼障碍、肌腱病变的神经可塑性周期化、奥运会损伤监测、跟腱病变、ACL 重建术后关节源性肌肉抑制以及腘绳肌损伤等，但没有具体的新事件发生。

It's merely a BJSM blog archive page, aggregating links to recent articles on popular rehabilitation topics such as musculoskeletal barriers, neuroplastic periodization for tendinopathy, and arthrogenic muscle inhibition post-ACL reconstruction. If you're looking for a quick overview of these areas, you can browse through it.

items.title: Physical Performance and Central Nervous System–Active Analgesics Independently Predict 8-Year Fall Risk in Adults with or at Risk for Knee Osteoarthritis
items.summary: Physical performance and the use of central nervous system-active analgesics were identified as independent predictors of 8-year fall risk in adults with or at risk for knee osteoarthritis.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究强调，身体表现不佳和使用中枢神经系统作用的镇痛药是膝骨关节炎患者 8 年内跌倒风险的独立预测因素。这意味着在评估膝骨关节炎患者时，除了关注关节本身，也要筛查这些风险因素，这有助于早期识别高风险患者。
items.titleZh: 身体表现和中枢神经系统活性镇痛药独立预测膝骨关节炎成人 8 年跌倒风险
items.summaryZh: 研究发现，身体表现和使用中枢神经系统活性镇痛药是膝骨关节炎成人或高危成人 8 年内跌倒风险的独立预测因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study highlights that poor physical performance and the use of CNS-active analgesics independently predict an 8-year fall risk in knee OA patients. This means you should screen for these risk factors when assessing knee OA patients, aiding early identification of high-risk individuals.
items.limitation: 文章摘要未提供足够信息来评估具体研究设计局限性，需阅读全文。
items.limitationEn: The abstract does not provide sufficient information to assess specific study design limitations; full text review is required.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Shear wave elastography assessment of lumbar multifidus muscle elasticity and its correlation with clinical function in patients with lumbar disc herniation
items.summary: A study (n=32 LDH patients, 33 healthy controls) used shear wave elastography to assess lumbar multifidus muscle elasticity. LDH patients showed reduced muscle thickness and significantly higher resting-state elastic modulus (3.10 [2.90–3.32] kPa vs. 2.72 [2.57–3.25] kPa, P = 0.016), which strongly correlated with VAS scores (rs = 0.888) and moderately with ODI scores (rs = 0.742) but not with Macnab classification.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究揭示了腰椎间盘突出症（LDH）患者多裂肌的形态和弹性特征变化，并首次定量证实了静息状态弹性模量与疼痛和功能障碍的强相关性。尽管未建立因果关系，这为评估 LDH 患者的腰椎多裂肌状态提供了一个客观指标，有助于你更精准地进行临床评估和制定康复方案。
items.titleZh: 剪切波弹性成像评估腰椎间盘突出症患者腰部多裂肌弹性及其与临床功能的相关性
items.summaryZh: 一项研究（32 名腰椎间盘突出症患者，33 名健康对照）使用剪切波弹性成像评估了腰部多裂肌弹性。腰椎间盘突出症患者表现出肌肉厚度减少和静息状态弹性模量显著升高（3.10 [2.90–3.32] kPa vs. 2.72 [2.57–3.25] kPa, P = 0.016），且与 VAS 评分（rs = 0.888）和 ODI 评分（rs = 0.742）呈强中度正相关，但与 Macnab 分类无关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study reveals changes in the morphology and elasticity of the lumbar multifidus muscle in lumbar disc herniation (LDH) patients and for the first time quantitatively confirms a strong correlation between resting-state elastic modulus and pain and dysfunction. Although no causal relationship was established, this provides an objective indicator for assessing the lumbar multifidus muscle status in LDH patients, helping you perform more precise clinical evaluations and develop rehabilitation plans.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，无法确立多裂肌弹性变化与腰椎间盘突出症的因果关系，且缺乏肌电图确认以区分肌肉激活或被动组织变化。
items.limitationEn: This study has a cross-sectional design, which precludes establishing a causal relationship between multifidus elasticity changes and lumbar disc herniation, and lacks electromyographic confirmation to differentiate between muscle activation or passive tissue changes.

items.title: Short term effectiveness of dry needling and instrument assisted soft tissue mobilization in knee osteoarthritis patients - a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial with 34 knee osteoarthritis patients found dry needling (DN) superior to instrument assisted soft tissue mobilization (IASTM) and conventional treatment (CT) in improving pain, function, and ROM at 4 and 6 weeks, with IASTM also outperforming CT for pain and function. All interventions showed comparable effects on muscle strength.
items.curatedReason: 这项小样本 RCT 提示，对于膝骨关节炎，干针在缓解疼痛、改善功能和 ROM 上优于 IASTM 和常规治疗。但干针和 IASTM 的样本量都偏小，在将它们推为主线方案前，你需要更高质量的证据。
items.titleZh: 干针与器械辅助软组织松动术对膝骨关节炎患者短期疗效的随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入 34 例膝骨关节炎患者的随机对照试验发现，干针在第 4 周和第 6 周改善疼痛、功能和关节活动度方面优于器械辅助软组织松动术（IASTM）和常规治疗，IASTM 在疼痛和功能改善方面也优于常规治疗。所有干预措施对膝关节肌肉力量的影响相似。
items.curatedReasonEn: This small RCT suggests dry needling is superior to IASTM and conventional treatment for pain, function, and ROM in knee OA. However, with limited sample sizes for both DN and IASTM, higher-quality evidence is needed before integrating them as primary interventions.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量小 (n=34)，仅限于短期效果评估 (6周随访)。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size (n=34) and limited follow-up (6 weeks) for assessing short-term effects.
items.journal: The Journal of manual & manipulative therapy
